The Master told him, "Be sure to take care of Xie Ren, and help him back onto the path of the righteous." Xie Ren turned to be powerful, but he was also a weirdo with a bad temper. While the other students were still learning to gather their qi, Xie Ren created a big fireball with just a slap on the table. 158407.description:
A modern man is reincarnated into the world of a fantasy game he knows well: as Werner, the son of a powerful noble. The thing is, Werner isn’t the hero or even the villain–he’s a background character likely to die during a climactic siege! Werner seeks out and befriends the hero, but he doesn’t have powerful enough skills to be a hero himself. Unwilling to die as a later plot point, Werner uses his knowledge of the game and his power as a noble to aid the hero and defend against evil attacks. That’s when he realizes that when he does so, he saves other people who were doomed as he was, which changes the “plot” he thought was inevitable. As the hero’s close comrade who can see the future, perhaps Werner will be a savior to this place, after all!

158432.description:
Tae, a beautiful 17-year-old high school girl, and Kotarou, a no-nonsense office worker, are living together. This seemingly happy couple share a secret they can't reveal to anyone - they are ninjas from the rival Iga and Kouga clans! A laid-back ninja cohabitation romantic comedy!

158434.description:
Xiao Zhenye fell in love with Mu Zijin at first sight. For him, he became an emperor while young; for him, he pacified the world and imprisoned him in the palace; but he was repeatedly hurt by his ignorance of love. And Mu Zujin didn't wish to stay with one person for long. To restore the country, he became Xiao Zhenye's "demon concubine", bringing disaster to his world. In the end, he committed suicide in front of Xiao Zhenye. Xiao Zhenye followed suite, committing suicide, but the two simultaneously returned to their childhood. What choice will Xiao Zhenye make this time...?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

158435.description:
"After returning to my hometown, my first order of business is to go on dating apps and meet strangers.”

After an anonymous hook-up, Dr. Hall and Dr. Winter suddenly became co-workers! Winter would rather forget about it, but Hall is more than interested in picking up where they left off. When Hall offers to be Winter’s sugar daddy, will he be able to resist this temptation?

158436.description:
After transmigrating into his sister's favorite novel, art student Ethan Ji must adjust to the perils of life as a bodyguard in the imperial palace. His plan for survival depends on the novel's main character, ninth prince Jian Mu. But there's just one problem: there's a limit to how friendly he can be before the prince becomes attached. Can he show the prince the right path and earn enough money to leave? Or will taming the tyrant become the very thing that ties them together forever?

(Source: Tapas)

158438.description:
Her dream is to become a shining star on the Broadway stage. From a young age, Suu grew up watching her mother work hard to support themselves while waiting for her father to return some day. When her mother passed away, Suu leaves for New York by herself, with memories of her kind mother in her heart. She wants to become a stage actress on Broadway, and she will make her dream come true, one step at a time.

(Source: eBookJapan, translated)

158439.description:
There's nothing more frustrating than a novel with endless tragedy and zero triumph. Such is the tale of Ophelia, a powerless princess who is used by those around her only to be cast aside and poisoned to death. So when an ordinary bookworm wakes up in the princess's body, she knows that she must rise to the throne in order to survive. Being the illegitimate daughter of the king is a setback, but luckily, she also happens to be the daughter of the palace temple's abbess. Once she pretends that she had a vision of her future self as the queen, the king starts relying on her "oracles" to guide his decisions. But even with her father's support, Ophelia knows that eliminating her political rivals won't be an easy task. Will the new heroine be able to scam her way to queendom, and more importantly, a happier ending?

(Source: Tappytoon)

158440.description:
Ethan Ardan definitely remembers dying, so when he wakes up in a dreary room with his sister who'd died, he can only presume it's the afterlife. It turns out Ethan has been reborn into an alternate timeline where his relatives bankrupted his family and dragged it into disgrace while he was in a 10 year-long coma! Now, it's up to Ethan to use his powerful skills from his past life to reunite his family, and to make his relatives rue the day they started a fight with House Ardan!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Regressed to My Ruined Family

158442.description: There is a disease of the mind that eventually shuts down all bodily functions. One woman effected with this disease has been ordered to be euthanized. Dr. Arlem fights for what he believes to be a way to cure her.

158443.description:
A short story about two beastmen on a journey and a human who was bought as a slave.

(Source: Booth, translated)

158444.description:
Yoo Gaeun is done with dating. After her ex left her to marry a famous actress, she now spends her days running her late mother's studio and cleaning up after her twin's messes. But her quiet life changes drastically when crude and cranky Kang Siwan moves into a nearby house. Though Gaeun tries to be civil to her odd neighbor, sparks fly every time they meet, causing one argument after another. Will she ever manage to make peace with Siwan, or will the sparks set fire to something else in her?

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Badao Xiao Cao Qiu Wo Huitou

158448.description:
A talented individual who is respected by many and welcomed anywhere? Not at all! A bloodthirsty battle fanatic who knows no defeat? Couldn’t be further from the truth! In reality, Deon Hardt is a sickly human who coughs up blood from receiving the tiniest bit of stress and gets sunburns from standing in the sun for ten minutes. But due to an unfortunate misunderstanding, he becomes “Demon Arut,” the notorious 0th corps commander of the demon army and the demon king’s joker. Caught in a war between humans and demonkind, Deon must find a way to survive!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Yuriel, a system host who traverses various worlds to fulfill missions, is renowned for his unparalleled beauty. His object, however, is to capture the heart of a designated mission target in each world in order to ensure his own survival. Surprisingly, all of his targets—the domineering CEO, the distant straight-A student, and the scheming prince—turn out to be the same man...

(Source: WebComics)

Xia Yuyang unexpectedly received a death invitation from his deceased grandfather. After experiencing seventeen deaths, he arrived at the Wheel of Reincarnation in Hell in hopes of rebirth. There, he learned that the only way to be reborn was to travel to various worlds, fulfill the regrets of the clients, and complete the tasks assigned by the system to earn points. His journeys through different worlds and the lives of various clients immersed him in these illusory realities. He gradually forgot his own identity. Who was he? What was his wish? In fact, all of this was a long-plotted return!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

As a photographer, he never thought that he would be betrayed by a model one day! And the other party is actually his boss?! Gao Wenrui protected his chest with both hands: "Boss, don't do it!!"

The sequel to the legendary dodgeball manga Honou no Toukyuuji Dodge Danpei! In this modern version of the hot-blooded dodgeball story, Danpei's daughter, Danko, follows in his footsteps, struggling to build a dodgeball team with the strongest fighting spirit in the modern age of 2025! Can Danko overcome the apathetic attitude of today's world?

(Source: Corocoro, translated)

158459.description:
Sora was summoned into a fantasy world from his native Japan to be a hero…but the only special skill he has is "Walking"! Its effect? "Walk as much as you want without getting tired." It sounds convenient, but it won't help in the fight against the demon lord! Rejected for his weakness, he's dumped outside the palace by the king's guards. But as he begins to walk away, he suddenly levels up! Each step taken earns one experience point…and soon, useful skills like Examine, Alchemy, and Domestic Magic are his to command! Who knew just taking a walk could be the key to a whole new world?

(Source: K MANGA)

158461.description:
In a girls' high school in rural Japan, Anna Glazkaya (Anya), a transfer student from a foreign country, had two secrets that no one knew. One was that she was a killing machine belonging to a Russian crime syndicate. The other is that she dislikes cats and is allergic to them, but if she does not play with a cat regularly, she will die.

Along with her cat-loving classmate Kohana and the enigmatic woman Akira, Anya's impossible mission to get along with cats has begun! The cats will lead the girls into all sorts of adventures - a comical and dangerous new kind of girl-meets-girl story!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

158464.description:
Lin Chuan, an antique restorer, accidentally stained a silk painting with his blood during restoration work. Unexpectedly, this caused the person in the painting to escape. As a result, Lin Chuan was framed for stealing antiques, fired from his studio, and burdened with millions in debt. Lin Chuan tried every possible way to find Xun Zhu, the person from the painting, hoping to send him back into the artwork to clear his name. Little did he know that all of this was a destiny determined a thousand years ago...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

158465.description:
Kaoru, a high school student infamously known as a fighting-fanatic, gains a sudden fascination with a new transfer student who is rumored to be incredibly dangerous. One day, he witnesses this mysterious underclassman, Shun, in a blood-boiling fight and ends up falling head-over-heels in love... But, when he goes to confess, he's mistaken as another attacker and must defend himself against the younger boy's lethal strikes! While the fight leaves Kaoru beaten and bruised, he suddenly finds himself being kissed...!? As if that wasn't confusing enough, Shun seems endeared by Kaoru's inexperience with love and agrees to date him, kicking off the start of a terrifying romance!

Hart, a self-destructive death row inmate, is drafted into a dangerous mission to go mining in the jungle. The leader of the jungle camp turns out to be his former lover, whom he broke up with long ago. Hart desperately tries to defy fate, but gradually falls into a dangerously inappropriate relationship.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The death of his childhood friend turned Su Mu's life upside down. Years later, Su Mu found himself returned in time, back to his youth 15 years before. Given a second chance, can he change fate and save his childhood friend?

Feng Lin, the "Dead Doctor", was the head of the Death Night, the most distinguished squad of the hidden legion of Huaxia. As per his father’s wish, he had to marry one of the ten beautiful ladies who were engaged to him. Not wanting to get married yet, Feng Lin decided to break off these engagements one by one. During this time, the traitor of Death Night, Liu Nian, appeared in the city. Then Feng Lin started his journey to seek vengeance and root out the “Netherworld”, which ultimately led to a civil war of the human race.

(Source: Webnovel)

Manatsu and Hoshiko are childhood friends. However, the shy Hoshiko becomes a popular idol, and Manatsu cannot accept the changes in Hoshiko's new life and new surroundings, so she becomes unfriendly toward Hoshiko.... Things change and things stay the same. A story of "change" and "conflict" spun between two girls.

(Source: Comic Ogyaaa!!, translated)

158472.description:
Eat, sleep, sex.

Fumi is a novelist who has lost her passion for writing. Now she lives with her man in an old house in the countryside. Nighttime picnics, a dip in the river, harvesting vegetables - they eat delicious food, sleep well, and have sex whenever and wherever they feel like it. It's like a never-ending summer vacation.

(Source: Bebe, translated)

158473.description:
When her sister, the king's fiancée, disappears, Countess Iris was forced to go to the royal palace to take her place. The king is rumored to be a tyrant, cursed with the blood of the silver wolf, that will surely lead to the ruin of his house! She tries to avoid it, but she ends up spending the night with him! Iris thought she was doomed, but then she finds out that the king, who is supposed to be a vicious beast, turns out to be more like a cuddly puppy dog, and she can't help but fall for him!

(Source: B's-Log Bunko, translated)

158474.description:
There are thousands upon thousands of demons in the world, and half of them reside in Zhaoye City. As for the other half, they all died in northern realm of Canlangli, under the control of the Celestial Immortal Xiao Fuxuan. Only one demon remained alive there, imprisoned for the last twenty-five years. He is Zhaoye City's former lord mayor, Wu Xingxue.

158484.description:
The end of the Edo period. It was vampires who forced Japan to open its borders to the outside world.

The year is 1853. Japan is in the midst of a turbulent period as it is forced to open its borders to the Western world, which is ruled by vampires. Hayato, a former member of the Shinsengumi, nearly loses his life when his comrades betray him. By chance, a vampire girl named Hearse, who has no memory of her own, appears on the scene. Hayato vows to take revenge even if it means forsaking his human identity, and chooses to become her servant.

At the same time, heroes from Europe and the United States gathered in pursuit of Hearse. Each of them manipulates their own unique bloody epitaphs and hunts down Hayato and Hearse. In addition, the story begins to take an unexpected turn when peculiar characters such as Soji Okita and John Manjiro appear one after another in front of the two.

Can Hayato get his revenge? Who exactly is the hearse? This blood-curdling tale of the Bakumatsu Restoration begins here!

Though many of these gifted humans, known as espers, choose to do good with their new powers, prolonged use always results in corruption - a darkening of the mind and soul. The very safety of society relies on the help of those who can guide this darkened energy, and thus the powerful Esper-Guide Association was born. Yet for Han Yun-Jae, though living as an undocumented esper proves to be both dangerous and illegal, joining the association simply isn’t an option. That is, until the mysterious and alluring Cha Min-Hyeong shows up: tall, dark, and oh-so-determined to become Yun-Jae’s own guide. The thing is, before he gives in to Min-Hyeong’s increasingly tempting offers, Yun-Jae needs to figure out why the other man is so insistent on guiding him, specifically…

They've got the skills, the brawn, and... a thirst for blood! Kaiser and Lina will take down anyone standing in their boss's way, but as the bodies pile up, Hoyeon starts to wonder if his lackeys aren't just insanely strong, but rather flat-out insane!

It has high reputation and the doctor, Kazuma Kishibe is a young handsome man of the same age with Kuroiwa. With his too much friendliness and proactivity, Kuroiwa is overwhelmed first, but the technique of chiropractic is fantastic and he feels too good like in heaven. "I'll make you...feel so good that you'll positively melt." Skillful handlings and accurate finger pressures make him sleep until next morning. Kuroiwa starts going to the lab but the doctor's treatment becomes more and more sexually aroused and at the same time, Kuroiwa feels more and more unable to resist as if his body has been changed from deep inside. It was 1946, shortly after the end of the war. A young girl orphaned by the war nearly freezes to death in a market in Otaru, Hokkaido. She is picked up by a blind man called Hakuganshi, who names her Mitsuko. Hakuganshi was a psychic, and for a small fee, she prayed for her clients to see their destiny and to be healed of their illnesses. Thoughtful and quiet, Hakuganshi lives with her older sister, Kayo.

She raised Mitsuko, who was not very good with her hands and not very smart, with great care and affection. However, when Mitsuko was in high school, she was reunited with a relative, and Mitsuko was cut off from Hakuganshi by her grandmother, who thought psychics were disreputable. Later, as an adult, Mitsuko gets married, becomes pregnant, and struggles with her daily life. One day, when her husband got into an accident at sea and presumed lost, Hakuganshi came to Mitsuko's bedside and leaves her a prophecy that her husband will return safely.

158954.description:
There was a globally popular game called "The Legend of the Seven Heroes." Ren cleared the sequel of that game at the fastest record in the world, and thus he obtained bonus special data. However, no matter where he looked inside the game, he could not find the data. The moment Ren was about to give up on the search, he decided to start playing the second round of the game. Suddenly, a notification message "Do you want to start a special story?" appears on the screen. When Ren chooses "Yes" without hesitation, he loses consciousness, and when he woke up, he was a baby.

Could it be that he was reincarnated as one of the heroes in "The Legend of the Seven Heroes"? Ren, who thought such a thing was impossible, could not believe his ears when he heard his name from his mother's mouth. It was the name of a classmate who betrays the heroes in the middle of the story. Of course, he wishes to live in peace. But in the game, he meets a saint whose life he's supposed to take, and doesn't. Furthermore, he ends up saving a character (the boss of a great noble family) who was supposed to die.

All of these things create a development that he doesn't know about...

158985.description:
Ikuo Fukami, a 12th grader who can sense people's emotions in colors, is summoned to a different world one day, surrounded by light. In this new world, he witnesses a scene where the woman who summoned him and her party are being attacked by a highly dangerous magical beast called a Riot Wolf. Although he has neither combat skills nor any battle-related abilities, Fukami possesses a unique power called "empathy," the only ability in the world that allows him to connect with magical beasts and communicate with them. Initially considered a disappointment, Fukami's true potential is soon revealed. Tired of the modern world, the high school student embarks on a journey to fight for the magical creatures and monsters in this new world, aiming for world peace. Thus begins an isekai tale of nation-building and adventure!

(Source: Mangamo)

158986.description:
Tomomi, a graduate student in the Department of Philosophy, has a crush on Professor Takatsuki, who is famous for being a sadistic teacher. After a drinking party, Takatsuki saved her from being taken away by a male student. Tomomi thought, "The professor is being so nice. It must be just a dream," even when Takatsuki leaned down and kissed her. When she woke up the next morning, she found herself in Takatsuki's bed. It wasn't just a dream! As Tomomi panicked, Takatsuki smiled coldly and proposed to her: "Why don't you marry me?"

(Source: Irie Novels, translated)

158995.description: Mami Inaba, also known as Mami-chan, is struggling to keep her diner running after 20 years, as the people of the sparsely-populated port town would rather go to the local mall. When the 74-year old Mami is about to give up, the missing popular young actress Hijiri Makoshi turns up at her diner. Will the duo be able to save the business?

158999.description:
Mineral collecting is like a modern-day treasure hunt!

Ruri, a high school girl who loves jewelry and accessories, gets into the world of mineral collecting, venturing into mountains, rivers, and caves. The first volume features numerous minerals, including quartz, garnet, pyrite, gold sand, and fluorite. The manga is full of fascinating scenes focusing on specialized tools such as a panning dish, hammer, and topographical maps. An authentic scientific adventure based on the author's solid knowledge of mineralogy!

(Source: Harta, translated)
